Champion Security: Apply security best practices (IAM, network, secrets) in collaboration with the security team, and contribute to pen-testing and security discussions. Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with other engineers (including our Data team in Spain and QA team in Berlin) to ensure development teams follow established processes. Plan & Prioritize: Participate in daily standups to align on priorities, unblock teammates, and contribute to the planning and prioritization of infrastructure work and new tooling requests. Your First Year Months 1 to 3, Onboard & Deliver: Get familiar with our production environment and daily workflows. By Month 6, Drive Cost Optimization: Follow strict cost control by taking a deeper look at how we utilize resources, databases, and tooling—optimizing our infrastructure to reduce spend without reducing capacity or performance. Debug issues safely, transfer knowledge to engineers, raise risks proactively, and partner across teams to plan and integrate new tools along project timelines. What You Bring Production AWS & Kubernetes Mastery: 3+ years of hands-on experience with AWS and Kubernetes in a real production environment, including public-facing applications where uptime and user impact matter. Cluster Upgrade Experience: Experience planning, running, or actively contributing to Kubernetes cluster upgrades and handling the resulting regressions. Solid IaC Practice: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform / OpenTofu. CI/CD & GitOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD). Security Fundamentals: Good grasp of AWS security fundamentals (IAM, roles, networking). Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Monitoring and alerting experience, paired with the ability to troubleshoot and root-cause production issues. Nice to Have: Experience with Managed Kafka (MSK) and RDS/Postgres (can also be learned on the job); Prometheus-compatible stacks (VictoriaMetrics), Grafana, Elasticsearch, and Sentry; Terragrunt, multi-region setups, and cloud cost optimization. Remote-First & Autonomous: Solid experience working remotely in a multidisciplinary environment—staying available, responsive, and able to unblock yourself and others without micromanagement. Pragmatic Collaborator: Excellent communication skills and high emotional and professional maturity. You propose solutions when articulating problems, value collective brainstorming over ego, and know how to balance performance, budget, and time. Quality & Architectural Awareness: A track record of high-quality work as evaluated by peers, with the ability to anticipate how your contributions affect the larger architecture, risk mitigation, and contingency plans. English Fluency: Good spoken and written English communication skills for daily collaboration across our international team. Our Tech Stack AWS Kubernetes Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / OpenTofu, Terragrunt) GitHub Actions, ArgoCD VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, ElasticSearch, Sentry PostgreSQL (RDS), Kafka (MSK) What We Offer Grow through coaching & doing: Access to your own certified coach, AIMY (our AI coach), and stretch opportunities beyond your role. 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere within your country of employment, with occasional opportunities to work from abroad, subject to approval. Time off that matters: Enjoy 30 days of annual leave, plus an additional Volunteering Day to give back to a cause you care about. Thrive in change: No boring days; we experiment, test, and learn. Agile ways of working, recognition for fresh ideas. Purpose in every role: Mission-driven work that changes lives, not just business results. Our Commitment to Inclusive Hiring At CoachHub, we’re building a workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, and lived experiences - because diverse teams create better ideas, deeper empathy, and bigger impact. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we encourage you to apply. Growth starts with taking a chance. As the leading talent development platform, organizations who use CoachHub benefit from increased employee engagement, higher levels of productivity, improved job performance and greater retention. Our scientific, holistic coaching approach has been formulated by our Innovation Lab, a collective of in-house learning experts, behavioral scientists and a dedicated Science Council of research leaders from around the world. Together, they leverage scientific evidence and platform insights to maximize business impact and drive innovation at CoachHub. Alongside its development and implementation of AI coaching, CoachHub has a global pool of over 3,500 certified business coaches in 90 countries across six continents, with coaching sessions available in over 80 languages. Serving more than 1,000 clients worldwide, CoachHub’s leading digital and AI coaching programs are based on proprietary scientific research, AI insights from renowned academics and development from its Innovation Lab. CoachHub is backed by leading tech investors, including Sofina, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Molten Ventures, Speedinvest, HV Capital, Partech and HSBC Innovation Banking. CoachHub was certified as a carbon-neutral company and consistently measures, reduces, and implements strategies to minimize its environmental impact.
